label: Bible Study
prompt: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this _____ from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
verse: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
note: Gethsemane's prayer — honest about the cup, surrendered about the outcome.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual _____.
verse: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
note: The afflicted have hard days, but a merry heart hath a continual feast — cheerfulness eats well.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with _____: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
verse: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.
note: Lazarus walked out still wrapped in graveclothes — Jesus' next instruction was simply, 'Loose him, and let him go.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: No doubt but ye are the people, and _____ shall die with you.
verse: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.
note: Job's sarcasm to his know-it-all friends: when you die, wisdom goes with you.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall _____ come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
verse: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
note: The verse behind the hymn 'Bringing in the Sheaves': tearful sowers 'shall doubtless come again with rejoicing.'
